hero.title: What Is a {{gold:Password}}?
hero.body: Every brave hero needs a way to prove who they are before entering the castle gates. In the digital realm, that proof is your {{cyan:password}}.

blocks.content: A {{gold:password}} is a secret string of characters that proves you — and only you — are allowed into an account. Think of it as the magic word at a castle gate: say it correctly, and the drawbridge lowers.
A secret combination of letters, numbers, and symbols used to verify your identity and protect an account from intruders.

blocks.title: DID YOU KNOW?
blocks.content: Most accounts also let you add a second proof of identity, like a code sent to your phone. This is called {{cyan:two-factor authentication}}.

blocks.title: WEAK GATES FALL FIRST
blocks.content: A weak password is like a drawbridge left halfway down — attackers can simply guess their way through with little effort.

blocks.author: Data Protector
blocks.content: A kingdom is only as safe as its weakest gate. Guard thy password as thou wouldst guard the crown jewels.

blocks.speaker: DATA PROTECTOR
blocks.content: Many young squires reuse the same password everywhere! If one castle falls, every castle falls with it.

blocks.title: MAKE IT LONG
blocks.content: Aim for at least {{code:12 characters}}. Longer passwords are exponentially harder to crack.

blocks.title: MIX IT UP
blocks.content: Combine uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols — for example {{code:Dr@gon$layer42}}.

blocks.title: KEEP IT UNIQUE
blocks.content: Never reuse a password across accounts. A {{purple:password manager}} can remember them so you don't have to.

blocks.title: NEVER DO THIS
blocks.content: Avoid {{red:"password123"}}, your name, or your birthday — these are the very first things attackers try.
Passphrases like {{green:"Castle-Moat-Dragon-99!"}} are easy for you to remember and hard for machines to guess.

blocks.alt: The Data Protector knight standing guard
blocks.caption: The Data Protector never lets a weak password through the gate.
